primer: DLF Limited (NSE: DLF) holds ₹15,084 Cr cash against ₹314 Cr debt, though ₹12,270 Cr sits in RERA escrow. Its 188 msf land bank and 50 msf DCCDL rental arm drove ₹20,143 Cr in FY26 sales, but 72% of land sits in Gurugram and H1FY27 sales fell 72% YoY to ₹4,460 Cr. We rate the business CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with a PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI grade. At ₹785.00 (42.55x P/E, 4.26x P/B, +14.40% above 50D SMA ₹686.16, RSI 73.74), Stage 2 momentum is strong, but our un-double-counted SOTP is ₹820.00/sh (0.69:1 support asymmetry < 1.50:1 gate), so we assign REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION). Revisit only below ₹650 or if H2FY27 bookings and operating cash flow prove a higher SOTP.
